unitTitle: The Expedition — Episode 2: The Jivaro Indians
audioRequiredUz: 2 va 5-mashqlarda 'listen' bor, lekin AUDIO KERAK EMAS: 2-mashqning oltala gapi 88-betdagi komiksda SO'ZMA-SO'Z bosilgan va har birining kimga tegishli ekani gap pufagidan ANIQ ko'rinadi. 5-mashq esa shunchaki dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qish.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures then read the sentences and circle the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri variantni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  AN ALLIGATOR
  2  A DOCTOR
  3  CAMERA
  4  SATISFIED


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Devidni timsoh quvmoqda.
  2  Devid va Sandra shifokor bilan uchrashadi.
  3  Hindu Sandraning fotoapparatini ko'rmoqchi.
  4  Mayk mamnun.


HAR BIRI QANDAY TASDIQLANADI:

  1  1-rasm: Devid 'An ALLIGATOR is after me!'
     deydi. Suvda timsoh ko'rinib turibdi.
     'a snake' (ilon) — rasmda yo'q.

  2  4-rasmdagi keksa odam — DOKTOR Hamperdin.
     5-rasmda o'zi aytadi: 'I'm their DOCTOR.'
     'the Indians' chief' (hindular boshlig'i) —
     epizodda umuman eslatilmagan.

  3  6-rasm: Sandra 'He wants to take my CAMERA!'
     deydi.
     'bag' (sumka) — epizodda yo'q.

  4  7-rasm: Mayk (muharrir) 'GOOD WORK, you two.
     This is a GREAT story and the pictures are
     FANTASTIC' deydi → u MAMNUN.
     'disappointed' (hafsalasi pir bo'lgan) —
     teskari ma'no.


DIQQAT — MAYK KIM:
  'Mike' — 7-rasmdagi muharrir (redaktor).
  Uning ismi bu betdagi 2-mashqda oshkor bo'ladi
  ('M for Mike').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a snake        = ilon
  a chief        = boshliq, sardor
  satisfied      = mamnun, qanoatlangan
  disappointed   = hafsalasi pir bo'lgan

items.textEn: 1  ............ is after David.
items.whyUz:
1-rasmda Devid aytadi:
'An ALLIGATOR is after me!'
Suvda timsoh ko'rinib turibdi.
'a snake' (ilon) epizodda YO'Q.

items.textEn: 2  David and Sandra meet ............ .
items.whyUz:
4-5-rasmlardagi keksa odam — DOKTOR Hamperdin.
U o'zi aytadi: 'I'm their DOCTOR.'
'the Indians' chief' (hindular boshlig'i)
epizodda umuman eslatilmagan.

items.textEn: 3  The Indian wants to see Sandra's ............ .
items.whyUz:
6-rasmda Sandra aytadi:
'He wants to take my CAMERA!'
'bag' (sumka) epizodda YO'Q.

7-rasmda Mayk (muharrir) aytadi:
'GOOD WORK, you two. This is a GREAT story and
the pictures are FANTASTIC.'
→ u MAMNUN.
'disappointed' = hafsalasi pir bo'lgan (teskari).

exercises.instructionEn: Who said the following? Listen to the episode and write S (for Sandra), D (for David), H (for Doctor Hamperdin) or M (for Mike).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni kim aytdi? Epizodni tinglang va S (Sandra), D (Devid), H (Doktor Hamperdin) yoki M (Mayk) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT QAHRAMON:
  S — SANDRA (jurnalist, sariq sochli ayol)
  D — DAVID  (jurnalist, qora sochli erkak)
  H — DOCTOR HAMPERDIN (keksa olim, shlyapali)
  M — MIKE   (Londondagi muharrir)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Here, hold on to this.            →  S
  2  Don't be afraid.                  →  H
  3  Everybody thinks that you're dead. →  D
  4  He won't hurt you.                →  H
  5  The Jivaro Indians love their land. →  H
  6  Good work, you two.               →  M


DIQQAT — AUDIO KERAK EMAS:
  Oltala gap ham 88-betdagi komiksda SO'ZMA-SO'Z
  bosilgan va gap pufagining DUMI kimga
  tegishli ekanini aniq ko'rsatib turibdi.


HAR BIRI QAYSI RASMDAN:

  1  2-rasm: Sandra Devidga eshkak uzatadi →
     'Here, hold on to this.'  →  S

  2  4-rasm: keksa odam hindular oldida →
     'Don't be afraid.'  →  H

  3  4-rasm: Devid keksa odamni tanib qoladi →
     'Everybody thinks that you're dead.'  →  D
     DIQQAT: bu gap DOKTORGA qaratilgan, demak
     uni doktorning O'ZI ayta olmaydi.

  4  6-rasm: Sandra qo'rqqanda doktor tinchlantiradi
     → 'He won't hurt you.'  →  H

  5  6-rasm: doktor hindularni tushuntiradi →
     'The Jivaro Indians love their land.'  →  H

  6  7-rasm: Londonda muharrir maqtaydi →
     'Good work, you two.'  →  M


NAQSh — DOKTOR ENG KO'P GAPIRADI:
  Uch gap (2, 4, 5) doktorniki — chunki u
  epizodning asosiy TUShUNTIRUVChI qahramoni.

pairs.whyUz:
2-rasm: Sandra suvdagi Devidga ESHKAKNI
uzatmoqda.
'hold on to' = mahkam ushlamoq.

4-rasm: hindular paydo bo'lganda keksa odam
jurnalistlarni tinchlantiradi.
Davomi: 'There is no need to panic.'

4-rasm: Devid keksa odamni TANIB qoladi.
DIQQAT: bu gap DOKTORGA qaratilgan
('YOU'RE dead'), demak uni doktorning O'ZI
ayta olmaydi.

6-rasm: Sandra hindudan qo'rqqanda doktor
uni tinchlantiradi.
'won't' = 'will not'.

pairs.left: 5  The Jivaro Indians love their land.
pairs.whyUz:
6-rasm: doktor hindularning nega ergashayotganini
tushuntiradi.
Doktor — epizodning asosiy TUSHUNTIRUVCHI
qahramoni (uch gap unga tegishli).

7-rasm: 'BACK IN LONDON' — tahririyatda
muharrir jurnalistlarni maqtaydi.
Maykning ismi shu mashqda oshkor bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the captions to the pictures.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT IZOH:
  1  the destruction of the rainforest
     (tropik o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi)
  2  Some people kill the animals.
     (Ba'zi odamlar hayvonlarni o'ldiradi.)
  3  People cut down trees.
     (Odamlar daraxtlarni kesadi.)
  4  The Jivaro Indians use some plants as
     medicine.
     (Xivaro hindulari ba'zi o'simliklarni dori
      sifatida ishlatishadi.)


TO'RT RASM:
  A — kesilgan daraxt tanalari uyumi, yog'och
      qoldiqlari
  B — kuygan/o'lik o'rmon, yalang'och tanalar,
      loyqa yer
  C — o'lik qush yerda yotibdi
  D — qo'lda o'simlik barglari, yonida shisha
      hovoncha va dastasi


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  A  →  3   (People cut down trees)
  B  →  1   (the destruction of the rainforest)
  C  →  2   (Some people kill the animals)
  D  →  4   (plants as medicine)


QANDAY ANIQLANDI:

  A: KESILGAN daraxt tanalari va yog'och uyumi
     → daraxtlarni KESISh jarayoni.

  B: Butun o'rmon YO'Q qilingan — faqat
     yalang'och tanalar va loyqa yer qolgan.
     Bu — jarayonning NATIJASI →
     'the DESTRUCTION of the rainforest'.

  C: O'LIK qush → hayvonlarning o'ldirilishi.

  D: Qo'ldagi o'simliklar va DORI TAYYORLASh
     asbobi (hovoncha) → 'plants AS MEDICINE'.


DIQQAT — A va B FARQI:
  A — HARAKAT ('People CUT DOWN trees')
  B — NATIJA ('the DESTRUCTION')
  Rasm A da hali daraxtlar kesilmoqda,
  rasm B da esa o'rmon allaqachon yo'q qilingan.


BOG'LIQLIK — 88-BETDAGI EPIZOD BILAN:
  Doktor aytgan edi:
  'They don't want anyone to KILL THEIR ANIMALS,
   CUT DOWN THEIR TREES or DESTROY THEIR HOMES.'
  Uchala izoh ham shu gapdan kelib chiqadi.
  To'rtinchisi esa:
  'The Jivaro Indians USE SOME OF THE PLANTS AS
   MEDICINE.'

pairs.leftUz: Kesilgan daraxt tanalari uyumi, yog'och qoldiqlari
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda KESILGAN daraxt tanalari ko'rinib turibdi.
Bu — HARAKAT (jarayon).
88-betda doktor: 'They don't want anyone to ...
CUT DOWN THEIR TREES.'

pairs.leftUz: Kuygan/o'lik o'rmon, yalang'och tanalar, loyqa yer
pairs.whyUz:
Butun o'rmon YO'Q qilingan — bu jarayonning
NATIJASI.
DIQQAT: A rasmidan farqi — u yerda daraxtlar
hali kesilmoqda, bu yerda esa hammasi tugagan.
'destruction' = yo'q qilish (OT).

O'LIK qush → hayvonlarning o'ldirilishi.
88-betda doktor: 'They don't want anyone to
KILL THEIR ANIMALS.'

pairs.right: 4  The Jivaro Indians use some plants as medicine.
pairs.leftUz: Qo'lda o'simlik barglari, yonida shisha hovoncha va dastasi
pairs.rightUz: Xivaro hindulari ba'zi o'simliklarni dori sifatida ishlatishadi.
pairs.whyUz:
Qo'ldagi o'simliklar va DORI TAYYORLASH asbobi
(hovoncha va dasta).
88-betda doktor: 'The Jivaro Indians USE SOME OF
THE PLANTS AS MEDICINE.'
Bu — yagona IJOBIY rasm.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ SAVOL — hammasining javobi 88-betdagi
komiksda bor.

Har bir savol epizodning MA'LUM bir rasmiga
to'g'ri keladi:
  1-savol  →  1-2-rasmlar
  2-savol  →  4-rasm
  3-savol  →  5-rasm
  4-savol  →  5-rasm
  5-savol  →  5-rasm
  6-savol  →  6-rasm
  7-savol  →  6-rasm
  8-savol  →  7-rasm

points.en: 1  Who saved David from the alligator?
points.uz: 1  Devidni timsohdan kim qutqardi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — 1-2-rasmlar.

points.en: Sandra did. She told him to forget his camera and gave him an oar to hold on to.
points.uz: Sandra qutqardi. U Devidga fotoapparatini unutishni aytdi va ushlash uchun eshkak berdi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
'Sandra DID' — qisqa javob ('did' takrorni
qoplaydi).
DIQQAT: 'Who saved ...?' — EGA savoli →
'did' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: 2  Who was the man Sandra and David met?
points.uz: 2  Sandra va Devid uchratgan odam kim edi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — 4-rasm.

points.en: He was Doctor Hamperdin, a famous doctor. Everybody thought that he was dead.
points.uz: U mashhur shifokor Doktor Hamperdin edi. Hamma uni o'lgan deb o'ylardi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Devid uni tanib qoldi: 'You are the famous
Doctor Hamperdin.'

points.en: 3  Who saved Doctor Hamperdin?
points.uz: 3  Doktor Hamperdinni kim qutqardi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — 5-rasm.

points.en: The Jivaro Indians did. They found him after his accident and saved him.
points.uz: Xivaro hindulari qutqarishdi. Ular baxtsiz hodisadan keyin uni topib, qutqarishdi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Doktor: 'I nearly died, but THESE PEOPLE FOUND
ME AND SAVED ME.'

points.en: 4  Where does he live now?
points.uz: 4  U hozir qayerda yashaydi?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL — 5-rasm.
DIQQAT: 'does ... live' — HOZIRGI zamon.

points.en: He lives in the rainforest with the Jivaro Indians.
points.uz: U tropik o'rmonda Xivaro hindulari bilan yashaydi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Doktor: 'Now I LIVE HERE WITH THEM.'
PRESENT SIMPLE — doimiy holat.

points.en: 5  What is he doing in the rainforest?
points.uz: 5  U tropik o'rmonda nima qilyapti?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL — 5-rasm.
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

points.en: He is their doctor and he is learning about the plants of the rainforest.
points.uz: U ularning shifokori va tropik o'rmon o'simliklari haqida o'rganyapti.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Doktor: 'I'm their doctor. I'M LEARNING about
the plants of the rainforest.'
Ikki ish: shifokorlik va o'rganish.

points.en: 6  What don't the Jivaro Indians want?
points.uz: 6  Xivaro hindulari nimani xohlashmaydi?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — 6-rasm.

points.en: They don't want anyone to kill their animals, cut down their trees or destroy their homes.
points.uz: Ular hech kim hayvonlarini o'ldirishini, daraxtlarini kesishini yoki uylarini vayron qilishini xohlashmaydi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
'want sb TO do sth' qolipi.
Uch ish: kill, cut down, destroy.
3-mashqdagi A, B, C rasmlari ham shu haqda.

points.en: 7  Does Doctor Hamperdin want to go back?
points.uz: 7  Doktor Hamperdin qaytib borishni xohlaydimi?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL — 6-rasm.
HA/YO'Q savoli.

points.en: No, he doesn't. He is happy there and he doesn't want anyone to know about him.
points.uz: Yo'q, xohlamaydi. U o'sha yerda baxtli va u haqida hech kim bilishini xohlamaydi.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Doktor: 'I'm happy here. I DON'T WANT TO GO BACK.'
va 'DON'T TELL ANYONE ABOUT ME.'
Qisqa javob: 'No, he doesn't.'

points.en: 8  What does David need to buy? Why?
points.uz: 8  Devid nima sotib olishi kerak? Nega?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL — 7-rasm.
IKKI qismli savol.

points.en: He needs to buy a new camera because an alligator ate his old one.
points.uz: U yangi fotoapparat sotib olishi kerak, chunki timsoh eskisini yeb qo'ygan.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
Sandra: 'David needs a new camera, though.
An ALLIGATOR ATE HIS OLD ONE!'
'because' — SABAB bog'lovchisi.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT ROL:
  SANDRA           — jurnalist ayol
  DAVID            — jurnalist erkak
  DOCTOR HAMPERDIN — keksa olim
  MIKE             — Londondagi muharrir


O'QISh MASLAHATLARI:

  1) OVOZ OHANGIGA e'tibor bering:
     • Devidning 'Sandra, HELP!' — QO'RQUV,
       baland ovozda
     • Sandraning 'Forget your camera.' —
       TEZKOR, qat'iy
     • Doktorning 'Don't be afraid.' —
       XOTIRJAM, sekin
     • Maykning 'Good work, you two.' —
       MAQTOV, iliq

  2) UNDOVLARNI ta'kidlang:
     'Phew!'  — yengil nafas
     'Hey!'   — hayrat
     'Oh no!' — noroziyoq/hazil

  3) OXIRGI HAZILNI to'g'ri ayting:
     'It wanted to take some SNAP shots of the
      jungle.'
     'snap' so'zini ta'kidlab ayting — bu SO'Z
     O'YINI.


HAR ROLNING GAP SONI:
  Sandra — 5 ta gap
  David  — 5 ta gap
  Doktor — 4 ta gap
  Mayk   — 1 ta gap

  Kichik guruhda Mayk rolini o'qituvchi yoki
  boshqa o'quvchi olishi mumkin.

points.uz: Epizodni tinglang va dialogni kuzatib boring.
points.noteUz: Avval TINGLANG — ohang va urg'uni eshiting.

points.noteUz: TO'RT rol: Sandra, David, Doctor Hamperdin, Mike.

points.en: Sandra, help! An alligator is after me! (frightened, loud)
points.uz: Sandra, yordam ber! Timsoh meni quvyapti! (qo'rqqan, baland ovozda)
points.noteUz:
QO'RQUV ohangi — undov belgilari buni
ko'rsatadi.

points.en: Don't be afraid. There is no need to panic. (calm, slow)
points.uz: Qo'rqmanglar. Vahimaga tushishga hojat yo'q. (xotirjam, sekin)
points.noteUz: Doktorning ohangi — XOTIRJAM, ishonchli.

points.en: It wanted to take some "snap" shots of the jungle. (joking)
points.uz: U jungli suratlarini olmoqchi edi! (hazil bilan)
points.noteUz: SO'Z O'YINI — 'snap' so'zini TA'KIDLAB ayting.

exercises.explanationUz:
EPIZODNING QISQAChA BAYONI — o'tgan zamonda.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  David 1) WAS scared BECAUSE an alligator 2) WAS
  after him. David and Sandra 3) WERE on the river
  bank WHEN they 4) SAW the Jivaro Indians with a
  white man. Sandra 5) DIDN'T KNOW him BUT David
  6) RECOGNISED him as Doctor Hamperdin. David
  7) WAS confused SO Doctor Hamperdin 8) EXPLAINED
  that he lived with the Jivaro Indians after his
  accident. He 9) SAID the Indians 10) LOVED their
  land AND they 11) WANTED to protect it. He
  12) PROMISED to help them write their article
  THEN he 13) ASKED them not to tell anyone about
  him.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Devid qo'rqib ketdi, CHUNKI uni timsoh quvardi.
  Devid va Sandra daryo bo'yida edilar, ShUNDA
  ular oq tanli odam bilan Xivaro hindularini
  ko'rishdi. Sandra uni tanimadi, LEKIN Devid uni
  Doktor Hamperdin sifatida tanidi. Devid
  dovdirab qoldi, ShUNING UChUN Doktor Hamperdin
  baxtsiz hodisadan keyin Xivaro hindulari bilan
  yashayotganini tushuntirdi. U hindular o'z
  yerlarini sevishini VA uni himoya qilishni
  xohlashini aytdi. U ularga maqola yozishda
  yordam berishga va'da berdi, KEYIN esa u haqida
  hech kimga aytmaslikni so'radi.


FE'LLARNING JAVOBLARI:
   1  was          (be, birlik)
   2  was          (be, birlik)
   3  were         (be, ko'plik — 'David and Sandra')
   4  saw          (see — NOTO'G'RI)
   5  didn't know  (INKOR)
   6  recognised   (to'g'ri fe'l)
   7  was          (be, birlik)
   8  explained    (to'g'ri fe'l)
   9  said         (say — NOTO'G'RI)
  10  loved        (to'g'ri fe'l)
  11  wanted       (to'g'ri fe'l)
  12  promised     (to'g'ri fe'l)
  13  asked        (to'g'ri fe'l)


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDA 'WERE':
  'David and Sandra' — IKKI odam → KO'PLIK →
  'WERE' ('was' XATO).
  Qolgan 'be' bandlari (1, 2, 7) BIRLIK → 'was'.

DIQQAT — 5-BAND INKOR:
  'Sandra 5) ...... (NOT/KNOW) him'
  → 'DIDN'T KNOW'
  'didn't knew' XATO — 'didn't' dan keyin
  ASOSIY shakl.

DIQQAT — 10 va 11-BANDLAR KO'PLIK EGA BILAN:
  'the Indians LOVED', 'they WANTED'
  Past simple da fe'l ega soniga qarab
  O'ZGARMAYDI.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  be  → was / were
  see → saw
  say → said

items.textEn: David 1) ............ (be) scared ...
items.whyUz:
'David' BIRLIK → WAS.
'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan.

items.textEn: ... an alligator 2) ............ (be) after him.
items.whyUz:
'an alligator' BIRLIK → WAS.
'be after sb' = kimnidir quvmoq.

items.textEn: David and Sandra 3) ............ (be) on the river bank ...
items.whyUz:
'David AND Sandra' — IKKI odam → KO'PLIK → WERE.
'was' XATO.
Bu — mashqning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan bandi.

items.textEn: ... when they 4) ............ (see) the Jivaro Indians with a white man.
items.whyUz:
see → SAW (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a white man' = oq tanli odam (Doktor Hamperdin).

items.textEn: Sandra 5) ............ (not/know) him ...
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE INKOR: DIDN'T + KNOW (ASOSIY shakl).
'didn't knew' XATO.
Sandra doktorni TANIMADI (Devid tanidi).

items.textEn: ... but David 6) ............ (recognise) him as Doctor Hamperdin.
items.whyUz:
recognise → RECOGNISED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'recognise sb AS ...' = kimnidir ... sifatida
tanimoq.
Britancha yozilishi '-ise'; amerikacha '-ize'.

items.textEn: David 7) ............ (be) confused ...
items.whyUz:
'David' BIRLIK → WAS.
'confused' = dovdirab qolgan, hayron.

items.textEn: ... so Doctor Hamperdin 8) ............ (explain) that he lived with the Jivaro Indians after his accident.
items.whyUz:
explain → EXPLAINED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'an accident' = baxtsiz hodisa.

items.textEn: He 9) ............ (say) the Indians ...
items.whyUz:
say → SAID (noto'g'ri fe'l; 'sed' deb o'qiladi).
DIQQAT: 'say THAT ...' — 'that' tushirib
qoldirilgan.

items.textEn: ... the Indians 10) ............ (love) their land ...
items.whyUz:
love → LOVED (to'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'the Indians' KO'PLIK bo'lsa ham,
past simple da fe'l O'ZGARMAYDI.

items.textEn: ... and they 11) ............ (want) to protect it.
items.whyUz:
want → WANTED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'want TO + asosiy fe'l' — qolip.
'to protect' = himoya qilmoq.

items.textEn: He 12) ............ (promise) to help them write their article ...
items.whyUz:
promise → PROMISED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'promise TO do sth' = ... qilishga va'da bermoq.
'help sb do sth' — 'to' TUSHIRILADI.

items.textEn: ... then he 13) ............ (ask) them not to tell anyone about him.
items.whyUz:
ask → ASKED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'ask sb NOT TO do sth' = kimgadir ... qilMASlikni
so'ramoq.
DIQQAT: 'not' 'to' dan OLDIN turadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVChI TANLOVI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BECAUSE  (sabab)
  2  WHEN     (vaqt)
  3  BUT      (qarama-qarshilik)
  4  SO       (natija)
  5  AND      (qo'shish)
  6  THEN     (ketma-ketlik)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  'David was scared ...... an alligator was
     after him.'
     → BECAUSE (SABAB)
     Nega qo'rqdi? — chunki timsoh quvardi.
     'and' shunchaki qo'shar edi, sababni
     ko'rsatmasdi.

  2  'They were on the river bank ...... they saw
     the Jivaro Indians.'
     → WHEN (VAQT)
     Qachon ko'rishdi? — daryo bo'yida turganda.
     'so' natija bildiradi — bu yerda mos emas.

  3  'Sandra didn't know him ...... David
     recognised him.'
     → BUT (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
     Sandra TANIMADI ↔ Devid TANIDI.
     Ikki teskari holat.

  4  'David was confused ...... Doctor Hamperdin
     explained ...'
     → SO (NATIJA)
     Devid dovdirab qoldi → ShUNING UChUN doktor
     tushuntirdi.

  5  'The Indians loved their land ...... they
     wanted to protect it.'
     → AND (QO'ShISh)
     Ikki bir-biriga MOS fikr.
     'but' teskarilikni bildiradi — bu yerda
     ikkalasi bir yo'nalishda.

  6  'He promised to help them ...... he asked
     them not to tell anyone.'
     → THEN (KETMA-KETLIK)
     Avval va'da berdi, KEYIN so'radi.
     'so' bo'lsa — so'rash va'daning NATIJASI
     bo'lardi, lekin unday emas.


BOG'LOVChILAR JADVALI (Unit 11, Workbook 45-bet):

  AND      →  qo'shish        (va)
  BUT      →  qarama-qarshilik (lekin)
  SO       →  natija          (shuning uchun)
  BECAUSE  →  sabab           (chunki)
  WHEN     →  vaqt            (... paytda)
  THEN     →  ketma-ketlik    (keyin)


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN — 'SO' va 'BECAUSE' FARQI:
  A BECAUSE B  →  B — SABAB, A — natija
  A SO B       →  A — sabab, B — NATIJA

  'He was scared BECAUSE an alligator was after
   him.'
  = 'An alligator was after him SO he was scared.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, tartib TESKARI.

items.textEn: David was scared ............ an alligator was after him.
items.uz: Devid qo'rqib ketdi, chunki uni timsoh quvardi.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Nega qo'rqdi? — CHUNKI timsoh quvardi.
'and' shunchaki qo'shar edi, sababni
ko'rsatmasdi.

items.textEn: David and Sandra were on the river bank ............ they saw the Jivaro Indians.
items.uz: Devid va Sandra daryo bo'yida edilar, shunda ular Xivaro hindularini ko'rishdi.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Qachon ko'rishdi? — daryo bo'yida TURGANDA.
'so' NATIJA bildiradi — hindularni ko'rish
daryo bo'yida bo'lishning natijasi emas.

items.textEn: Sandra didn't know him ............ David recognised him as Doctor Hamperdin.
items.uz: Sandra uni tanimadi, lekin Devid uni Doktor Hamperdin sifatida tanidi.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARSHILIK.
Sandra TANIMADI ↔ Devid TANIDI.
Ikki TESKARI holat.
'then' ketma-ketlikni bildiradi — bu yerda
ikkalasi BIR VAQTDA sodir bo'lgan.

items.textEn: David was confused ............ Doctor Hamperdin explained that he lived with the Jivaro Indians.
items.uz: Devid dovdirab qoldi, shuning uchun Doktor Hamperdin tushuntirdi.
items.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Devid dovdirab qoldi → SHUNING UCHUN doktor
tushuntirdi.
Tushuntirish — dovdirashning NATIJASI.

items.textEn: He said the Indians loved their land ............ they wanted to protect it.
items.uz: U hindular o'z yerlarini sevishini va uni himoya qilishni xohlashini aytdi.
items.whyUz:
AND — QO'SHISH.
Ikki fikr BIR YO'NALISHDA:
yerni sevish → himoya qilishni xohlash.
'but' teskarilikni bildiradi — bu yerda
teskarilik YO'Q.

items.textEn: He promised to help them write their article ............ he asked them not to tell anyone about him.
items.uz: U ularga maqola yozishda yordam berishga va'da berdi, keyin esa u haqida hech kimga aytmaslikni so'radi.
items.whyUz:
THEN — KETMA-KETLIK.
Avval VA'DA BERDI, KEYIN so'radi.
'so' bo'lsa — so'rash va'daning NATIJASI
bo'lardi, lekin unday emas: bular ikki ALOHIDA
ish.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the events and put them in the correct order, then tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealarni o'qing va to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring, so'ng hikoyani aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BIR VOQEA — IKKALA EPIZODNI qamrab oladi
(1-epizod 'The Waterfall' 68-69-betlar,
 2-epizod 'The Jivaro Indians' 88-bet).

Kitob BIRINCHISINI bergan:
  'Sandra and David got on a plane to Brazil.' — 1


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

   1  Sandra and David got on a plane to Brazil.
      (Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga samolyotga
       chiqishdi.)                        [BERILGAN]

   2  They went to the jungle.
      (Ular jungliga borishdi.)

   3  They heard drums and saw the Jivaro Indians.
      (Ular baraban ovozini eshitishdi va Xivaro
       hindularini ko'rishdi.)

   4  They ran to the river.
      (Ular daryo tomon yugurishdi.)

   5  They found a canoe.
      (Ular kanoe topishdi.)

   6  They fell down a waterfall.
      (Ular sharsharadan qulab tushishdi.)

   7  Sandra saved David from an alligator.
      (Sandra Devidni timsohdan qutqardi.)

   8  They met Doctor Hamperdin.
      (Ular Doktor Hamperdin bilan uchrashishdi.)

   9  Doctor Hamperdin told them about the Jivaro
      Indians.
      (Doktor Hamperdin ularga Xivaro hindulari
       haqida gapirib berdi.)

  10  Sandra and David came back to London.
      (Sandra va Devid Londonga qaytishdi.)

  11  Mike was satisfied with their article.
      (Mayk ularning maqolasidan mamnun bo'ldi.)


QAYSI VOQEA QAYSI EPIZODDAN:
  1-EPIZOD (68-69-betlar):  1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
  2-EPIZOD (88-bet):        7, 8, 9, 10, 11


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — 1-EPIZODDAN:
  • 'Sandra and David are in an AEROPLANE to
     Brazil.'                          → 1-voqea
  • 'I don't like the JUNGLE.'          → 2-voqea
  • 'Can you hear the DRUMS?' +
    'It's the JIVARO INDIANS!'          → 3-voqea
  • 'Sandra, RUN! Let's go to the RIVER.' → 4-voqea
  • 'Look ... a CANOE! Quick! Let's get in it.'
                                        → 5-voqea
  • 'Oh, no! A WATERFALL!' + 'Help!'    → 6-voqea

QANDAY ANIQLANDI — 2-EPIZODDAN:
  • timsoh sahnasi (1-2-rasmlar)        → 7-voqea
  • Doktor Hamperdin bilan uchrashuv
    (4-rasm)                            → 8-voqea
  • doktorning tushuntirishi (5-6-rasmlar)
                                        → 9-voqea
  • 'BACK IN LONDON ...' (7-rasm)       → 10-voqea
  • Maykning maqtovi (7-rasm)           → 11-voqea


DIQQAT — 4 va 5-VOQEALAR TARTIBI:
  Avval DARYO tomon YUGURIShDI, keyin u yerdan
  kanoe TOPIShDI.
  1-epizodda: 'Let's go to the river' →
  'Look ... a canoe!'

DIQQAT — 10 va 11-VOQEALAR TARTIBI:
  Avval LONDONGA QAYTIShDI, keyin Mayk maqolani
  o'qib MAMNUN bo'ldi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a canoe    = kanoe (yengil qayiq)
  a waterfall = sharshara
  drums      = barabanlar
  satisfied with = ... dan mamnun

pairs.right: Sandra and David got on a plane to Brazil.
pairs.rightUz: Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga samolyotga chiqishdi.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN.
1-epizodning birinchi rasmi:
'Sandra and David are in an AEROPLANE to Brazil.'
'get ON a plane' — transportga chiqish predlogi ON.

1-epizod: mehmonxonadan jip bilan jungliga
yo'l olishdi.
Sandra: 'I don't like the JUNGLE. It makes me
nervous.'

pairs.right: They heard drums and saw the Jivaro Indians.
pairs.rightUz: Ular baraban ovozini eshitishdi va Xivaro hindularini ko'rishdi.
pairs.whyUz:
1-epizod: 'Sh!!! Listen! Can you hear the DRUMS?'
keyin 'Oh no! It's the JIVARO INDIANS and they
don't look friendly.'

1-epizod: 'Sandra, RUN! Let's go to the RIVER.'
Hindulardan qochish uchun.

1-epizod: 'Look ... a CANOE! Quick! Let's get
in it.'
DIQQAT: avval daryo tomon yugurishdi, KEYIN
u yerdan kanoe topishdi.

1-epizod: 'Oh, no! A WATERFALL!' va 'Help!'
Bu — 1-epizodning oxiri va uning NOMI
('The Waterfall').
fall → FELL.

pairs.right: Sandra saved David from an alligator.
pairs.whyUz:
2-epizodning BOSHI (1-2-rasmlar).
Sandra unga eshkak uzatdi.
'save sb FROM sth' — predlog FROM.

2-epizod, 4-rasm: daryo bo'yida hindular bilan
birga keksa oq tanli odam turardi.
meet → MET.

pairs.right: Doctor Hamperdin told them about the Jivaro Indians.
pairs.rightUz: Doktor Hamperdin ularga Xivaro hindulari haqida gapirib berdi.
pairs.whyUz:
2-epizod, 5-6-rasmlar: doktor hindularning
o'simliklarni dori sifatida ishlatishini va
yerlarini himoya qilishini tushuntirdi.
tell → TOLD.

pairs.right: Sandra and David came back to London.
pairs.whyUz:
2-epizod, 7-rasm: 'BACK IN LONDON ...'
come → CAME.
'come back to' = ... ga qaytmoq.

pairs.right: Mike was satisfied with their article.
pairs.whyUz:
2-epizod, 7-rasm: Mayk 'GOOD WORK, you two.
This is a GREAT story' dedi.
'satisfied WITH' — predlog WITH.
1-mashqning 4-bandi ham shu haqda edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in the missing adjectives from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va ro'yxatdan yetishmayotgan sifatlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta):
  many, large, serious, longest, whole


TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  The Amazon Rainforest is a 1) LARGE beautiful
  forest in Brazil, South America. It lies at the
  mouth of the Amazon River. The Amazon river is
  the 2) LONGEST river in South America. It runs
  between the Andes Mountain Ranges and the
  Atlantic Ocean.

  The Amazon Rainforest is a very beautiful place.
  A wide variety of animals, birds and insects live
  in it. There are also 3) MANY trees and plants.

  Today, the forest has a very 4) SERIOUS problem.
  People are cutting down too many of its trees. As
  a result, much of its animal and plant life is
  disappearing forever. Trees and plants are very
  important to the environment. Some scientists say
  that the 5) WHOLE world is in danger because of
  the destruction of the rainforests.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Amazonka tropik o'rmoni — Janubiy Amerikaning
  Braziliya davlatidagi katta va go'zal o'rmon.
  U Amazonka daryosining quyilish joyida
  joylashgan. Amazonka — Janubiy Amerikadagi eng
  uzun daryo. U And tog' tizmalari bilan Atlantika
  okeani orasidan oqib o'tadi.

  Amazonka tropik o'rmoni — juda go'zal joy. Unda
  turli-tuman hayvonlar, qushlar va hasharotlar
  yashaydi. Shuningdek ko'plab daraxt va
  o'simliklar bor.

  Bugun o'rmonda juda jiddiy muammo bor. Odamlar
  uning daraxtlarini haddan tashqari ko'p
  kesishmoqda. Natijada uning hayvonot va nabotot
  olamining ko'p qismi butunlay yo'q bo'lib
  bormoqda. Daraxt va o'simliklar atrof-muhit
  uchun juda muhim. Ba'zi olimlarning aytishicha,
  tropik o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli
  butun dunyo xavf ostida.


HAR BIR JAVOB QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'a ...... beautiful forest'
     → LARGE (katta)
     'a' artikli bor → BIRLIK sifat kerak.
     'many' ko'plik bilan keladi → mos emas.
     'longest' va 'whole' 'the' talab qiladi.
     'serious' o'rmon uchun mos emas.

  2  'the ...... river in South America'
     → LONGEST (eng uzun)
     'THE' bor va '... in South America' →
     ORTTIRMA daraja kerak.
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona orttirma shakl — 'longest'.

  3  'There are also ...... trees and plants.'
     → MANY (ko'p)
     'trees and plants' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK →
     'many'.
     'much' bo'lsa sanalmaydigan ot kerak edi.

  4  'a very ...... problem'
     → SERIOUS (jiddiy)
     'a very' bor → ODDIY sifat.
     Muammo haqida → 'serious'.
     Keyingi gaplar tasdiqlaydi: daraxtlar
     kesilmoqda, hayvonlar yo'qolmoqda.

  5  'the ...... world is in danger'
     → WHOLE (butun)
     'the whole world' = butun dunyo.
     Turg'un birikma.


DIQQAT — MATN EPIZOD BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  Devid va Sandra aynan shu mavzuda maqola
  yozgan edilar:
  'We came here to write an article about the
   DESTRUCTION OF THE RAINFOREST.'
  Matnning oxirgi gapida ham aynan shu ibora bor.


MATNDAGI GRAMMATIKA:
  'People ARE CUTTING DOWN too many of its trees.'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir davom etmoqda)
  'much of its animal and plant life IS
   DISAPPEARING'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  'TOO MANY of its trees'
     → 'too many' = haddan tashqari ko'p
       (sanaladigan ot bilan)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lie          = joylashgan bo'lmoq
  the mouth of a river = daryoning quyilish joyi
  a mountain range = tog' tizmasi
  a variety of    = turli-tuman
  an insect       = hasharot
  serious         = jiddiy
  as a result     = natijada
  to disappear    = yo'q bo'lmoq
  forever         = butunlay, abadiy
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a scientist     = olim
  in danger       = xavf ostida
  because of      = ... tufayli
  the whole world = butun dunyo

items.sentence: 1  The Amazon Rainforest is a ............ beautiful forest in Brazil, South America.
2  The Amazon river is the ............ river in South America.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THE' bor va '... IN South America' →
ORTTIRMA daraja kerak.
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA orttirma shakl — LONGEST.
Unit 12 ning grammatikasi.

items.sentence: 3  There are also ............ trees and plants.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'trees and plants' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK otlar →
MANY.
'much' sanalmaydigan otlar bilan keladi.
'There ARE' — ko'plik fe'li ham buni tasdiqlaydi.

items.sentence: 4  Today, the forest has a very ............ problem.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'a VERY' bor → ODDIY sifat kerak.
Muammo haqida → SERIOUS (jiddiy).
Keyingi gaplar tasdiqlaydi: daraxtlar kesilmoqda,
hayvonlar yo'q bo'lib bormoqda.

items.sentence: 5  Some scientists say that the ............ world is in danger because of the destruction of the rainforests.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'the WHOLE world' = butun dunyo — TURG'UN
birikma.
'whole' = butun, to'liq.
DIQQAT: 'the whole world' ✓,
'a whole world' — boshqa ma'no.

patterns.formula: A + PAST SIMPLE + BECAUSE + B + PAST SIMPLE.   /   A + PAST SIMPLE + SO + B + PAST SIMPLE.
patterns.exampleEn: David was scared because an alligator was after him. David was confused so Doctor Hamperdin explained.
patterns.exampleUz: Devid qo'rqib ketdi, chunki uni timsoh quvardi. Devid dovdirab qoldi, shuning uchun doktor tushuntirdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because' dan KEYIN — sabab.
'so' dan KEYIN — natija.
Ikkalasi teskari yo'nalishda.

patterns.formula: ega + ASK + kimdir + NOT TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: He asked them not to tell anyone about him.
patterns.exampleUz: U ulardan u haqida hech kimga aytmaslikni so'radi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'ask sb NOT TO do sth' — inkor iltimos.
DIQQAT: 'not' 'to' dan OLDIN turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: The Amazon river is the longest river in South America.
patterns.exampleUz: Amazonka — Janubiy Amerikadagi eng uzun daryo.
patterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja + 'IN' (joy bilan).
Unit 12 ning grammatikasi.

patterns.formula: People ARE CUTTING DOWN too many of ... . AS A RESULT, ... IS DISAPPEARING.
patterns.exampleEn: People are cutting down too many of its trees. As a result, much of its animal and plant life is disappearing forever.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar uning daraxtlarini haddan tashqari ko'p kesishmoqda. Natijada hayvonot va nabotot olamining ko'p qismi butunlay yo'q bo'lib bormoqda.
patterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir davom etayotgan
jarayon.
'as a result' = natijada (sabab-oqibat).

patterns.formula: The whole world is in danger BECAUSE OF + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: The whole world is in danger because of the destruction of the rainforests.
patterns.exampleUz: Tropik o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli butun dunyo xavf ostida.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because OF' dan keyin faqat OT keladi.
'because' dan keyin esa GAP (ega + fe'l).
